### Install

1. Download **GlassBell-Setup.exe** below and run it. No administrator rights are needed. The installer is not code-signed, so SmartScreen may warn: **More info → Run anyway**.
2. Turn on **Do not disturb** (Settings → System → Notifications), so that the Windows banners do not show next to the GlassBell ones.

Windows 11, 64-bit. Русское описание — в [README.ru.md](https://github.com/vibegineer/GlassBell/blob/main/README.ru.md).
